title: Game Relics
statementMd:
Esports is a form of competitive sports using video games. Dota 2 is one of the most popular competitive video games in Esports. Recently, a new video game Dota 3 was released. In Dota 3 a player can buy some relics for their hero. Relics are counters that track hero's actions and statistics in a game.

Gloria likes to play Dota 3, so she wants to buy all n available relics for her favorite hero.

Relics can be bought using an in-game currency called shards. Each relic has its own price — ci shards for the i-th relic. A player can buy a relic using one of the following options:

- Pay ci shards to buy the i-th relic;
- Pay x shards and randomly get one of all n relics. The probability of getting a relic is the same for all n relics. If a duplicate relic is received, then the relic is recycled and x2 shards are given back to the player.

Gloria wants to buy all n relics. Help her minimize the expected number of shards she spends to buy all the relics.

## Input

The first line contains two integers n and x (1≤n≤100; 1≤x≤10000) — the number of relics and the cost to receive a random relic.

The second line consists of n integers c1,c2,…,cn (x≤ci≤10000; ∑ci≤10000) — the prices of n relics.

## Output

Print a single real number — the minimum expected number of shards that Gloria must spend to buy all the relics.

The absolute or relative error should not exceed 10−9.

## Note

In the first example, the optimal strategy is to randomly get one of the two relics paying 20 shards. Then there are two scenarios.

The first one happens if Gloria receives the first relic. Then she keeps getting random relics until she obtains the second relic. The expected number of shards to spend in this scenario is 20+30=50.

In the second scenario, Gloria initially gets the second relic. Then it is better to buy the first relic for 25 shards, so the expected number of shards to spend in this scenario is 20+25=45.

Thus, the expected number of shards to spend is 50+452=47.5.
statementZhMd:
<statement>
电子竞技是一种以电子游戏为载体的竞技体育。Dota 2 是电子竞技中最受欢迎的竞技类电子游戏之一。最近，一款新电子游戏 Dota 3 发布了。在 Dota 3 中，玩家可以为自己的英雄购买一些圣物。圣物是用于记录英雄在游戏中的行为和统计数据的计数器。

Gloria 喜欢玩 Dota 3，因此她想为自己最喜欢的英雄买齐全部 $n$ 件圣物。

圣物可以使用一种名为碎片的游戏内货币购买。每件圣物都有自己的价格：第 $i$ 件圣物的价格为 $c_i$ 碎片。玩家可以通过以下任意一种方式购买圣物：

- 支付 $c_i$ 碎片，购买第 $i$ 件圣物；
- 支付 $x$ 碎片，从全部 $n$ 件圣物中随机获得一件。获得每件圣物的概率均相同。如果获得了重复的圣物，该圣物会被回收，并向玩家返还 $\frac{x}{2}$ 碎片。

Gloria 想要买齐全部 $n$ 件圣物。请帮助她最小化买齐所有圣物所花费的碎片数量的期望值。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $n$ 和 $x$（$1 \le n \le 100$; $1 \le x \le 10\,000$），分别表示圣物的数量和随机获得一件圣物的费用。

第二行包含 $n$ 个整数 $c_1, c_2, \ldots, c_n$（$x \le c_i \le 10\,000$; $\sum{c_i} \le 10\,000$），表示这 $n$ 件圣物的价格。

## 输出格式

输出一个实数，表示 Gloria 买齐所有圣物所需花费的碎片数量的最小期望值。

绝对误差或相对误差不得超过 $10^{-9}$。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，最优策略是先支付 $20$ 碎片，随机获得两件圣物中的一件。随后有两种情况。

第一种情况是 Gloria 获得了第一件圣物。此后，她不断随机获取圣物，直到获得第二件圣物。在这种情况下，花费的碎片数量的期望值为 $20 + 30 = 50$。

第二种情况是 Gloria 一开始获得了第二件圣物。此时，直接花费 $25$ 碎片购买第一件圣物更优，因此在这种情况下，花费的碎片数量的期望值为 $20 + 25 = 45$。

因此，花费的碎片数量的期望值为 $\frac{50 + 45}{2} = 47.5$。
</statement>
